description: This file defines the internal class GrainReferenceRuntime implementing IGrainReferenceRuntime, responsible for managing grain method invocation, including handling filters, invoking methods asynchronously, and casting grains within the Orleans runtime.

classes.name: GrainReferenceRuntime
classes.description: Implements IGrainReferenceRuntime, managing grain method invocation, including filters, asynchronous calls, and casting within Orleans.

methods.name: InvokeMethodAsync<TResult>
methods.description: Invokes a grain method asynchronously with a result, applying filters if present.

methods.name: InvokeMethodAsync
methods.description: Invokes a grain method asynchronously without a result, applying filters if present.

methods.name: InvokeMethod
methods.description: Invokes a grain method in a fire-and-forget manner, with one-way option.

methods.name: InvokeMethodWithFiltersAsync<TResult>
methods.description: Handles invocation with filters asynchronously, returning a typed result.

methods.name: InvokeMethodWithFiltersAsync
methods.description: Handles invocation with filters asynchronously, without returning a result.

methods.name: Cast
methods.description: Casts a grain to a specified interface or reference type.

methods.name: SetGrainCancellationTokensTarget
methods.description: Associates GrainCancellationToken arguments with the target grain reference.
